'''Thranz''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Thranz and Senator [[Falit]] were [[Assassination attempt on Falit and Thranz|rescued]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ardun Kothe]] from an assassination attempt.
